But maybe we can use displayCarStatus(option="fuel") to see fuel status. That returns some output. Then we can decide.

We also might need to get zipcodes for cities. There's get_zipcode_based_on_city(city). So we could get zipcodes for SF and Rivermist. Then estimate_distance uses zipcodes. Actually estimate_distance expects cityA and cityB as zip codes. So we need to call get_zipcode_based_on_city twice. Then estimate_distance. Then estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage(distance). That returns feasibility. Then we can respond accordingly.

1. get_zipcode_based_on_city("San Francisco")

4. estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage(distance=estimatedDistance)

Then we can interpret result. If feasible true, say yes else no. Provide distance. Possibly mention approximate miles. We'll do it.
